hero.title: Block ChickenEvery Chicken on Chain.
hero.desc: The next-generation poultry traceability platform. Using UHF RFID tags, IoT sensors, and blockchain anchoring — we give every chicken a digital passport from hatchery to supermarket.

journey.title: Nine Checkpoints, Full Transparency
journey.sub: From the moment a chick hatches to the second a consumer picks it off the shelf — every checkpoint is logged with RFID scans, IoT sensor data, and GPS timestamps.

features.title: Built for the Modern Poultry Industry
features.sub: Combining UHF RAIN RFID, IoT environmental sensors, and optional blockchain anchoring — we deliver the most comprehensive poultry traceability solution on the market.
features.f1p: Isolate recalls in minutes, not days. Pinpoint exactly which batches are affected using real-time RFID scan history.
features.f2p: Your customers scan a QR code and see the full journey — farm origin, processing date, cold chain integrity, and certifications.
features.f3p: FDA FSMA 204, EU Farm-to-Fork Strategy, CFIA mandates — built to meet global food traceability standards.
features.f4p: Temperature breaches, transit delays, missed checkpoints — get SMS and dashboard alerts the moment something goes wrong.
features.f5p: Optional Hyperledger Fabric anchoring for tamper-proof audit trails. Every critical event hash is immutable on-chain.
features.f6p: $0.05–$0.15 RFID tags, ~$65/checkpoint hardware. Designed for million-bird operations with ROI from day one.

testimonials.title: Trusted Across the Entire Supply Chain
testimonials.sub: From university caterers to supermarket chains, farmers to families — see why the whole supply chain is switching to Block Chicken.
testimonials.t1: Since rolling out Block Chicken at our campus canteens, student satisfaction with food transparency has jumped 40%. Students love scanning the QR code to see exactly which farm their Hainanese chicken rice came from. For a university that prides itself on tech, this is a no-brainer.
testimonials.t2: Before Block Chicken, when there was a food scare, we'd lose weeks of sales while they traced the source. Now? 30 minutes — they scan the batch, isolate the affected birds, and the rest of my farm keeps selling. My premium free-range chickens now sell at 25% higher price because buyers can verify the claim.
testimonials.r2: Owner, Kam Tin Free-Range Farm, Yuen Long
testimonials.t3: Our customers increasingly demand to know where their food comes from. Block Chicken gives us that competitive edge — every pack on our shelf has a QR code that tells the full story. Sales of traceable chicken are up 35% since launch. It's become our #1 differentiator.
testimonials.t4: The IoT temperature sensors saved us from a $200K claim. A reefer unit malfunctioned mid-route and Block Chicken's real-time alert caught it within 10 minutes. We rerouted the truck and saved the entire shipment. Our insurance premiums dropped 15% after installing the system.
testimonials.t5: USDA inspectors love our setup. Every carcass is tracked from intake to packaging — RFID on the conveyor line means zero paperwork, zero manual logs. We passed our FSMA 204 audit in record time. The blockchain anchoring gives our export buyers in Japan and the EU total confidence.
testimonials.r5: Plant Manager, Tai Po Poultry Processing
testimonials.t6: As a mom of two, food safety is everything to me. I used to just buy whatever was cheapest. Now I ONLY buy chicken with the Block Chicken QR code — I scan it, see the farm, see the cold chain was intact, see the halal cert. It's worth paying a bit more for peace of mind.
